target.title: fix(plugins): bound hosted catalog feed reads on non-streaming responses
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`readHostedCatalogResponseText` in `src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog.ts` used two read paths: the streaming branch incrementally enforced `maxBytes`, but the non-streaming branch called `response.text()` first and only checked the byte count afterward. That check-after-allocate pattern could OOM on oversized bodies when the response was not stream-backed or when `Content-Length` was missing or wrong.

## Why This Change Was Made

Route all hosted catalog feed reads through the shared `readResponseWithLimit` helper from `src/infra/http-body.ts`, reusing the same byte cap, idle timeout, and overflow error contract as other bounded HTTP reads. This deletes the duplicate streaming loop and the unsafe `response.text()` branch.

## User Impact

Normal hosted catalog loads are unchanged. Oversized feeds now fail at the shared byte cap instead of buffering the full body first on the non-streaming path.

## Evidence

Focused tests:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog.test.ts --run --reporter=verbose
```

Result: **54/54 passed**, including two new regressions for non-stream-backed and streaming oversized feeds.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Non-streaming hosted catalog feed reads could allocate the full response body before enforcing `maxBytes`.
- **Real environment tested:** macOS (Darwin), Node.js v22.22.0, `node:http` loopback server on `127.0.0.1`.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
  1. `node --import tsx scripts/proof-hosted-catalog-bound.mjs`
  2. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog.test.ts --run --reporter=verbose`
- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
$ node --import tsx scripts/proof-hosted-catalog-bound.mjs
  ok: unbounded read pulled the full oversized feed (1572963 bytes)
  ok: rejected oversized hosted catalog feed
  ok: bounded error message present
  ok: small non-streaming hosted feed still loads

ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS PASSED
```

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog.test.ts --run --reporter=verbose
 ✓ rejects oversized hosted feeds when the response body is not stream-backed
 ✓ rejects oversized streaming hosted feeds incrementally

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  54 passed (54)
```

- **Observed result after fix:** `loadHostedOfficialExternalPluginCatalogEntries` rejects a ~1.5 MiB loopback feed at the 1 MiB cap with `hosted catalog feed exceeds 1048576 bytes`; a small non-stream-backed feed still loads as `hosted`; negative control shows unbounded `getReader()` would read the full body.
- **What was not tested:** Live ClawHub hosted catalog endpoints; proof used loopback fetch and mocked `fetchImpl` only.

## Tests and validation

- `node --import tsx scripts/proof-hosted-catalog-bound.mjs` (local proof script, not committed)
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog.test.ts --run --reporter=verbose`
- Regression tests added in `src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog.test.ts`

## Risk checklist

- Did user-visible behavior change? Yes — oversized hosted feeds error at the cap on all response shapes, not only stream-backed bodies.
- Did config, environment, or migration behavior change? No
- Did security, auth, secrets, network, or tool execution behavior change? Yes — hosted catalog feed reads now use one bounded HTTP reader.
- Highest-risk area: plugin catalog refresh / hosted feed fallback behavior on large but legitimate feeds.
- Mitigation: default cap remains 1 MiB; successful feeds are far below it; bundled fallback behavior is unchanged on overflow.

## Current review state

- Next action: awaiting maintainer review
- Bot comments addressed: none yet

## AI-assisted disclosure

- [x] AI-assisted (Cursor agent)
- [x] Human-run Real behavior proof from local setup
